name: deep-health-uptime-handlers-node
description: Reference /health/deep endpoint handlers (Node.js) for the deep-health-uptime-canary solution. Copy the folder matching your datastore into your app.
comment: This manifest lists dependencies across ALL Node reference handlers. A given handler only needs a subset: express + (pg | redis | mongodb | @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb | @aws-sdk/client-s3). external-api and opensearch use only Node built-ins (https) + express.
